To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) UX is a distinct and extended perspective on product quality, which focuses on the human, and on the drivers of positive experiences, (ii) that UX is not just "new wine in old bottles" but a truly extended and different perspective, and that (iii) UX is an important perspective on quality, which is relevant to all stakeholders of interactive products, and which can help us to understand the quality of interactive products better.

1) the quality of the user experience is a key determinant of product success, 2) the quality of experience is a multidimensional construct, 3) there are many different types of experiences, 4) there are many drivers of experience, 5) the drivers of experience vary by experience type, and 6) experience is a dynamic, evolving phenomenon.
1) The experience is the product.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of the experience of people in relation to interactive products, systems, and services.
the quality of the experience of people interacting with interactive technologies.
understanding and supporting the design of interactive systems that are enjoyable to use and that support people's goals and activities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
User experience (UX) is the overall quality and satisfaction of a person's interaction with a product or system, and how that product or system makes the person feel.
UX is a new paradigm for HCI.
UX is a perspective on product quality that is based on a human-centered view of the world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been trying to develop a theory of UX.
we are interested in the design of interactive products and services that are easy to learn, easy to remember, and easy to use.
we have been able to identify and measure a new and distinct construct, namely the user experience (UX) of technology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of interactive products and services is not determined by the product itself, but by its ability to support the user's goals and needs.
the quality of a product is not a product property, but a property of the interaction between the user and the product.
UX is not a new name for a traditional HCI problem.
